Initial release: Quickly prepares you for your next meeting with agenda, attendees, and linked docs.

- Adds the +meeting-prep workflow to review the next meeting details.
- Supports custom calendar selection with --calendar flag.
- Offers flexible output formats: json, table, yaml, csv.
- Read-only; does not modify your calendar data.
- Integrates with global flags and authentication via gws-shared.
